sources.title: FurniMesh — AI Image to 3D Model Generator for Furniture
sources.snippet: FurniMesh is anAI image to 3Dplatform that turns furniture photos into production-ready3D modelsin under 60 seconds. Upload a photo of a chair, sofa, table, lamp, or any furniture piece, and the AI returns a textured 3D model inGLB, OBJ, SKP, or BLENDformat. Used by 22K+designers, retailers, architects, and 3D artists in 100+countries, who have generated 71K+furniture models so far.
